description: The National Infrastructure Pipeline of Te Waihanga, the New Zealand Infrastructure Commission, gives insight into planned infrastructure projects across New Zealand to help industry coordinate and plan project delivery. Users can search the pipeline for planned projects by location, timing, organisation and other criteria, read pipeline snapshots of sector trends, learn what information is held, and contribute projects. The downloadable pipeline data has moved to the Commission's Insights Platform, which offers individual reports on the performance of New Zealand's infrastructure system, with a contact address for questions. The Commission also publishes the National Infrastructure Plan (March 2026). Access is free online; no licence is stated on the pages read. Caveats: the pipeline records planned projects submitted by organisations, so coverage depends on contributions, and the Insights Platform is rendered by scripts. Coverage is New Zealand. It supports capacity planning and economic analysis of infrastructure investment across transport, water, energy and social infrastructure; related records are the Infrastructure Partnerships Australia pipeline reports and OpenCUP of Italy.
